name: Rust

env:
  RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
  RUSTDOCFLAGS: -D warnings

jobs:
  fmt-crank-check:
    name: Format + check
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          lfs: true

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Install packages (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: awalsh128/cache-apt-pkgs-action@v1.6.0
        with:
          packages: libxcb-xfixes0-dev libxkbcommon-dev libssl-dev libgtk-3-dev # libgtk-3-dev is used by rfd
          version: 1.0
          execute_install_scripts: true

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          prefix-key: "v2"
          shared-key: "brush"
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
          cache-workspace-crates: true

      - name: Rustfmt
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      # clippy subsumes `cargo check` (same lints plus more), so no separate
      # check step for the all-features config.
      - name: clippy
        run: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: check --no-default-features
        run: cargo check --locked --workspace --no-default-features --all-targets

      # `--document-private-items` is a superset of the public-docs run.
      - name: cargo doc
        run: cargo doc --workspace --document-private-items --no-deps --all-features

  wasm-check:
    name: Check wasm32
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          lfs: true

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          prefix-key: "v2"
          shared-key: "brush-wasm"
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
          cache-workspace-crates: true

      # The browser build (brush-app / brush-js cdylibs) is only compiled for
      # wasm32; the host-only jobs above never exercise it. Check it here so a
      # wasm-only break can't ship green.
      - name: check wasm32 (browser crates)
        run: cargo check --locked -p brush-app -p brush-js --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
